source_citations.provider: Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service (CAMS) — Atmosphere Data Store (ADS)

transformation_rule: Extract ambient surface air pollutant concentrations (NO2, PM10, PM2.5, CO in ug/m3) over the Ionian Islands bounding box (37.0-40.5N, 19.0-22.0E) from CAMS European air quality ensemble analysis (D-008 confirmed Data15 = Ambient Air Quality).

refined_data.values_ug_m3.NO2.region_mea.description: Regional mean surface NO2 across the Ionian bounding box (1.96 ug/m3).

refined_data.values_ug_m3.PM10.region_me.description: Regional mean surface PM10 across the Ionian bounding box (8.99 ug/m3).

refined_data.values_ug_m3.PM2.5.region_m.description: Regional mean surface PM2.5 across the Ionian bounding box (5.76 ug/m3).

refined_data.values_ug_m3.CO.region_mean.description: Regional mean surface CO across the Ionian bounding box (158.14 ug/m3).

refined_data.source: CAMS European air quality forecasts (ADS), ensemble analysis
refined_data.note: CO2 is NOT a CAMS regional variable; nearest airport-level pollutants are NO2/PM10/PM2.5/CO.
